brief: A sturdy slab serif for headlines, signage and short text: direct and confident, with heavy square serifs and an engineered feel.

why.serifs: Slab serifs nearly as thick as the thin strokes give the sturdy, structural look the brief asks for.
why.thin: 76 against a stem of 104 is low contrast, so nothing looks delicate.
why.aperture: Closed apertures and square dots add the engineered feel.
why.proportions: Even widths keep headlines steady and blocky.
